basic.name: Punish
basic.description: Step forward dealing 113~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds.

basic.name: Condemn
basic.description: After 1 second, Johanna pulls nearby enemies toward her, Stunning them for 0.25 seconds and dealing 55~~0.04~~ damage. Deals 200% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

basic.name: Shield Glare
basic.description: Deal 59~~0.04~~ damage to enemies and Blind them for 1.5 seconds.

heroic.name: Falling Sword
heroic.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225~~0.04~~ damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

heroic.name: Blessed Shield
heroic.description: Deal 114~~0.04~~ damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

trait.name: Iron Skin
trait.description: Activate to grant Johanna a Shield that absorbs 810~~0.04~~ damage for 4 seconds. While this Shield is active, Johanna is Unstoppable.

activable.name: Laws of Hope
activable.description:
Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.

Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

activable.name: Steed Charge
activable.description:
Activate to instantly Mount for 4 seconds, unhindered by damage.

Passive: Increase the duration of Iron Skin by 2 second.

activable.name: Blessed Hammer
activable.description:
Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

activable.name: Blinded By The Light
activable.description:
Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 8 seconds.

activable.name: Indestructible
activable.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Johanna gains a Shield equal to her maximum Health for 4 seconds.

level1.name: Zealous Glare
level1.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level1.name: Divine Fortress
level1.description:
Basic Attacks grant 10 Physical Armor for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40.

Gambit: Gain 25% bonus maximum Health. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

level1.name: Laws of Hope
level1.description:
Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.

Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

level4.name: Subdue
level4.description:
Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.

Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.

Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level4.name: Eternal Retaliation
level4.description: Mark enemies hit by Condemn for 10 seconds. Johanna's next Basic Attack against them removes the mark, lowering the cooldown of Condemn by 1 second, refunding 10 Mana, and killing Minions.

level4.name: Hold Your Ground
level4.description: Increases Iron Skin's Shield by 40% and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

level7.name: Sins Exposed
level7.description: Punish reduces healing received by 35% for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.

level7.name: Conviction
level7.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level7.name: Steed Charge
level7.description:
Activate to instantly Mount for 4 seconds, unhindered by damage.

Passive: Increase the duration of Iron Skin by 2 second.

level13.description: Increase Punish's damage by 50%. This bonus is increased to 150% whenever Punish hits 2 or more Heroes.

level13.name: Holy Fury
level13.description: Deal 15~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

level16.name: Shrinking Vacuum
level16.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 30% and Slows by 30% for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Holy Renewal
level16.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

level16.name: Blessed Momentum
level16.description: Basic Attacks grant 10% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40%. They also reduce Johanna's Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level20.name: Heaven's Fury
level20.description: Falling Sword rains down holy bolts, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage to enemies, healing allied Heroes for 68~~0.04~~, and reducing its cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level20.name: Radiating Faith
level20.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blessed Shield by 2. Its Stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and all targets hit are Stunned for the maximum duration.

level20.name: Indestructible
level20.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Johanna gains a Shield equal to her maximum Health for 4 seconds. This effect has a 120 second cooldown.
